summary: WeRide Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return under Hong Kong listing rules. The filing reports a share buyback: on May 21, 2026, the company repurchased 765,000 ordinary shares on the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong at an average price of HKD 19.49 per share, reducing issued shares (excluding treasury) from 944,044,685 to 943,279,685. The shares were held as treasury, increasing treasury holdings to 29,228,356. No cancellation was disclosed. This open-market repurchase represents a capital return to shareholders. Watch for ongoing buyback pace and impact on share count and liquidity.
